column1: # The response-level stop (common.repair --skip_below D) in place of the token floor, on the
# shuffled exact-undo step: training's step sizes and frozen second moment, alpha 1, seed 0,
# every group once a pass in T updates (90 multihop, 50 creatures), 6 passes. A pushed-down
# completion is left out of an update while its mean log-prob is more than D nats/token
# below the anchor's. Weights kept after 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 passes, all evaluated (panel
# A, token drift) while the replay runs. The closest existing arm is the shuffled floored
# undo (shuffled_undo_tamia.tsv: the same batches, the token floor, 2 passes).
# docs/OFFLINE_DESIGN.md, tuning order. One job per line and per D, one B200 each:
#   for d in 20 40; do for l in 1 2 3 4; do
#     LINES=$l METHOD=undo SHUFFLE=1 FLOOR= SKIP_BELOW=0.$d ARM_TAG=skip$d \
